projects.name: President of Women in Computer Science
projects.description: Student-led organization at Diablo Valley College aiming to promote and support the growing number of women in CS on and off-campus. Managed 58 members gaining 4 awards in hackathons, expanding club membership by 75% through weekly meetings and activities.

projects.name: Lead Organizer of DVCHacks
projects.description: Led 15 people to pioneer DVC’s first public hackathon, a 24-hour coding competition filled with 4 technical workshops sponsored by Google and Amazon engineers. Acclaimed as DVC’s Best Event of the Year 2018-2019 with a total of 88 participants.

projects.name: Sports Teammates For U
projects.description: Designed and developed an end-to-end platform for sports networking, venue rentals, and referee hiring using React, Django, and Firebase Authentication. Integrated landing page, user registration and login, dashboard and its contents with back-end APIs.

projects.name: UCSD Web Optimization
projects.description: Mirrored and hosted UCSD site on Github Pages, improving its performance score to 70%. I modified the main render-blocking font file; deferred, minified, extracted critical JS & CSS files; optimized images (resize, reformat, compress); and utilized CDN.

projects.name: Marketing Designer & Secretary of DVC Earth Club
projects.description: A volunteering club focuses on spreading environmental awareness and preserving natural surroundings through the education of eco-friendly habits. I initiated the club's website, designed weekly posters for promotion, handled meeting minutes and roster.

projects.name: World Savvy
projects.description: Rewarded with an Amazon Echo Dot in Amazon Alexa Skills Challenge for building an educational quiz game for kids using Alexa SDKs for Node.js and Amazon Web Services (AWS) Lambda.

projects.name: Travel Master
projects.description: Awarded “From 0 to 60” in my first hackathon, CodeDay Bay Area 2017, for developing a web application using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Google Maps API which can show all countries’ information and national anthem.
